# Infrastructure Migration Checklist: Critical Thinking Questions on Writing Posts

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements covering the D1 database replacement, new `ai` and assets bindings, deploy order, docs and CI
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [contracts/worker-config.md](../contracts/worker-config.md), [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test whether the requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable; they do not test the implementation.

## Database Replacement

- [ ] CHK001 Are the new database names, both environments and the old names to be deleted listed once and identically across spec, plan, contract and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Contract §worker-config]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the order of operations defined (create, migrate, swap ids, deploy, verify, delete old) with the explicit rule that old databases are deleted only after a successful deploy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the claim "existing contact data need not be kept" backed by a stated assumption and a stop condition if contact data turns out to exist? [Assumption, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a rollback path defined if the deploy fails after the new ids land (old databases still present, ids reverted)? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the interim state (new names with old ids on the branch) specified, with the rule that it cannot merge, and is that rule enforced by a named check? [Clarity, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK006 Are all migrations (`0001` contact and `0002` questions) required to run on both new databases, with a defined way to confirm they were applied? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the Cron Trigger and contact retention behaviour specified as unchanged on the renamed databases? [Coverage, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the D1 limitation (no rename, so create-and-swap) recorded as the reason for the approach? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications]

## Bindings and Configuration

- [ ] CHK009 Are the `ai` and `ASSETS` bindings required in both environments (production and preview) with the names the code uses stated once? [Completeness, Contract §W01-W04]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it specified that bindings and database ids are committed in `wrangler.jsonc` and applied through CI, with no dashboard-only configuration? [Consistency, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the `run_worker_first` and `/api/*` routing requirement stated as unchanged, so only API paths invoke the Worker? [Clarity, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK012 Are generated Worker types (`wrangler types`) required to be regenerated and checked so binding names cannot drift? [Measurability, Contract §W05]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the Workers Builds or deploy-token permission needed for the `ai` binding stated, with who adds it and what the failure looks like? [Dependency, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the Wrangler token and secrets handling rule (repo `.env` token precedence, no `versions secret put` on this Worker) captured wherever deploy steps are written? [Gap, Plan §Constitution Check VIII]

## Deploy Scripts, Docs and Setup Check

- [ ] CHK015 Is every file that names the old databases enumerated in the requirements (deploy scripts, setup-check items, setup docs, walkthrough skill, test config), with a stated way to find stragglers? [Completeness, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the updated setup-check items (names, expected state, failure messages) specified so a reader can tell "new database missing" from "old database still present"? [Clarity, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK017 Are documentation updates required for `docs/setup.md`, `docs/testing.md` and the quickstart, with LIVE steps clearly marked as needing Don? [Completeness, Spec §Dependencies and Governance]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the privacy-policy change required before production deploy, not after? [Sequencing, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the post-migration cleanup (deleting old databases, removing stale references) a tracked requirement rather than an implied one? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]

## CI and Local Development

- [ ] CHK020 Is it required that CI runs the worker tests and Playwright without a Cloudflare login, given Wrangler treats `ai` as a remote binding? [Completeness, Plan §Risks, Research §R12]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the fallbacks named if the `ai` binding blocks local startup (stub binding, remote bindings off) and the criterion for choosing one? [Clarity, Research §R12]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the requirement that tests use a fake `AI` and fake `ASSETS` stated, and is it clear no test may call the real model? [Clarity, Plan §Test placement]
- [ ] CHK023 Are Playwright and unit tests that reference the old database name listed as requirements to update, with the rule that no check is weakened? [Consistency, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK024 Are preview deployments required to use `dcc-web-preview` and its own bucket, and is that separation verifiable from configuration alone? [Measurability, Spec §FR-021]

## Governance and Rollout

- [ ] CHK025 Is the major-change handling (label, auto-merge off, `[PREVIEW-CHECK]` items, reason in PR body) stated for every trigger in the plan header? [Completeness, Constitution §III, Plan §header]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the preview checks Don must perform enumerated (question quality, placement, live database steps) with pass criteria? [Measurability, Plan §header]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the constitution amendment (v2.2.0) consistent with the final endpoint behaviour described in spec and plan (cache, bucket, no personal data)? [Consistency, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK028 Is coordination with sibling worktrees that touch `wrangler.jsonc`, deploy scripts, `PostLayout.astro` or `docs/setup.md` specified, including when `main` is merged and baselines regenerated? [Coverage, Plan §Constitution Check XI]
